messages:
Sam Chen: quick heads-up — after the int8 quant bring-up for qwen-13b we see a consistent quality regression on the long-context QA eval set (CONTEXT-10k). baseline (gemma-13b fp16) EM=78.4, qwen-13b int8 EM=74.1. not tiny. :thinking_face:
Anya Patel: ugh, that's big. did you compare tokenization + vocab rows? often a vocab offset eats accuracy.
Sam Chen: doing that now. initial suspicion: rotary/kv cache indexing mismatch + vocab id shift when we swapped tokenizers. i have a minimal reproducer, will paste.
Sam Chen: reproducer prompt (sanitized): 
```
System: answer short factual questions from the context.
Context: <long article ~6k tokens>
User: what year did the company IPO?
```
Model config used: `rotary_scale=1.0, rotary_base=10000, quant_type=int8, tokenizer=community/qwen-tokenizer@v2`
Frank Li: can you dump raw token ids for the first 200 tokens from both tokenizers (ours vs community)? if ids differ by a constant offset, that's a red flag. also rotary sin/cos indexing depends on token position and head dims — mismatch there can scramble attention.
Sam Chen: good call. attached quick diff: our tokenizer -> first tokens [101, 345, 876, ...], community -> [103, 347, 878, ...] so looks like a +2 offset for non-special tokens. ci job confirmed histogram skew. :eyes:
ci-bot: integration/tokenizer-vs-model histograms: non-special-token-id-shift = +2 for 97.3% of tokens across 50 samples. link: ci/internal/ci-job/1775 (private).
Marta Svensson: that explains it. if embeddings are fetched with the wrong row, the model effectively sees shifted word vectors. for long-context QA the effect compounds. check tokenizer special token mapping — gemma fork used `vocab_special_offset=0`, qwen-community sets `vocab_special_offset=2`.
Anya Patel: two immediate mitigation paths: 1) patch our onboarding pipeline to assert `tokenizer.vocab_size == model.config.vocab_size` and `tokenizer.convert_tokens_to_ids(special_tokens)` are within model.vocab range, 2) run a quick remap during load to align ids (temporary). we should also gate rollout if long-context EM drop > 2.0.
Frank Li: also verify rotary indexing overlay: if we changed `rotary_base` or applied a per-head scale, the kv cache offsets used during incremental decoding may be off by a factor, causing positional interpolation errors. quick test: run identical inputs through fp16 gemma and int8 qwen while capturing KV cache keys and compare values at the same positions.
Sam Chen: i ran a small key-index check: keys at step t from qwen-runtime are shifted by 2 positions relative to gemma runtime for the same literal tokens (after mapping). so both vocab and kv index errors present. hypothesis: tokenizer offset introduced by community tokenizer plus our runtime's assumption about rotary position numbering (we start positions at 0, community expects 2?)
Marta Svensson: wild. patch plan:
- immediate: add tokenizer-id assertions + abort onboarding if mismatch (Anya)
- short term: automatic remap with explicit `vocab_offset` param for the conversion script (Sam/Frank)
- medium: add rotational-index regression tests that feed a small canonical sequence and assert KV-cache alignment across runtimes
Sam Chen: proposed quick remap snippet i used to validate locally: 
```
# quick remap to align community tokenizer -> our model
def remap_token_ids(ids, offset):
    return [i - offset if i >= 30000 else i for i in ids]
# ad-hoc: offset=2 for this tokenizer
```
Anya Patel: for onboarding pipeline change i suggest also capture a small eval (200 long-context QA items) and compute EM/F1 delta vs baseline model. block if EM drop > 2.0 or F1 drop > 3.0. Add the check in `onboard/evals.py`. :white_check_mark:
Frank Li: i ran the remap + int8 quant run on 10 samples — EM improved from 74.1 -> 77.9, still slightly below gemma fp16 but within noise for some workloads. latency delta ~ +0.5ms/token. results saved in /bench/qwen-int8-remap/177514.
Marta Svensson: i'll open the tokenizer PR to pin `vocab_special_offset` and add a small integration test that compares token ids for the first 512 tokens against the model's embedding rows. cc @infra for canary rules.
Sam Chen: thanks all. next steps: PRs for tokenizer patch + onboarding assertion + add rotary KV alignment test. i'll file the rollout hold until we have the gate in place. :lock:
Anya Patel: assign me for the onboarding gate change, i'll add the thresholds and a short docs note for model owners.
Frank Li: i'll follow up with a deeper root-cause repro and try a more exact kv-index fix (prob a one-line change in the runtime offset calc).
ci-bot: created issue REDWOOD-ML-1124 for onboarding gate, attached logs.
Marta Svensson: PR 2481 opened (tokenizer: pin vocab offset + add id alignment test). link: github.com/redwood-inference/tokenizers/pull/2481
Sam Chen: awesome. i'll re-run the full 200-sample eval after PR lands. thanks! :rocket:
